messages.subject: Trouble with rJava
parts:
Hello

can someone help me with this one? I'm trying to get Deducer to work
but I'm stuck on an outdated rJava that doesn't seem to update.
However, when I check the library-map my installed rJava is the newest
available (0.8.1). Is there a fix for this one? Thanks
BTW: I'm working on a Windows XP computer

> Loading required package: JGR
Loading required package: rJava
Loading required package: JavaGD
Loading required package: iplots

Loading required package: Deducer
Error: package 'rJava' 0.6-3 is loaded, but >= 0.7 is required by
'Deducer'
In addition: Warning message:
package 'Deducer' was built under R version 2.10.0

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: Trouble with rJava
parts:
Pieter,

check that you don't have any non-standard library locations. the
.libPaths() function will list your libraries. The path where you
found rJava 0.8.1 should be the only entry. Then update your packages
with update.packages(repos="http://cran.r-project.org") . If there
were multiple entries, you can update that tree with
update.packages(lib.loc="put the path here",
repos="http://cran.r-project.org") , or you can just delete rJava, JGR
and Deducer from that path.

Make sure that you have R 2.10.0 or greater installed.


Ian
